_doc: Reels text-animation techniques re-implemented as frame-deterministic studio motion tracks. Source: a user-provided reference gallery (no third-party code shipped). Plays in K/P/R via lib/motion.js / motion.py. Units: x/y/blur in em (px converted at REF_PX=40), rotate deg, scale x, opacity 0..1. colorRole is a semantic brand token resolved by the renderer (never a hex). captionSafe=false means boxed/highlight/gradient — use for cards/CTAs, not unboxed captions.
